ObjectName.value: Cardiff University Trans Rights Protest June 2021

Categories.value: CC-Zero|Cardiff University|Transgender rights activists|Self-published work|Demonstrations and protests in support of transgender rights in the United Kingdom|LGBTQ rights in Wales

ImageDescription.value:
On June 21st 2021 a protest was held outside of the Cardiff University building. This was due to a number of lecturers signing a letter asking Cardiff University to leave the Stonewall Diversity Championships scheme.

The lecturers claimed they were concerned about Stonewall's impact on "academic freedom and respect for all staff and students."

Students the letter was a reaction to Stonewall's support for transgender people, and protested outside the university to call for a response to the letter and protections for transgender students.
